CLOUD FIXER seat for PR #2709 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head e64d997862766735cb0f48e6d720f8b878de4046. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch e64d997862766735cb0f48e6d720f8b878de4046 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-fly-cloud-setup-toolchain, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-fly-cloud-setup-toolchain <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-fly-cloud-setup-toolchain; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Continue from the PR head of fix/r10-fly-cloud-setup-toolchain (the pushed handoff); do not restart from main. Merge origin/main first. Implement roster carry index 6 of R10-FLY-CLOUD-SETUP-TOOLCHAIN (roster db3e513ec, wave-r10-groups.json) in this PR: pool claims (triage dev/programme/triage/s6-batch4.md#S6-V1 and #S6-V2). In cloud_dispatch's pool path: (1) when it appends a line for a topic, delete any existing claim/<session>/<topic> ref whose handoff ref has not moved since the claim (stale claim -> POOL EMPTY); (2) the POOL push must not discard stderr: push, read the ref back, refuse with the git error on mismatch (no 2>/dev/null). Controls: a stale claim is cleared and the run claims the line (null control: a claim whose handoff ref moved after the claim is left alone); a forced push failure prints the error and exits nonzero; one mutant per arm. No change to the pool routine prompt. Then re-run prepr to a pass and push handoff/ and handoff-body/ refs as the fixer contract says.
